fields.statement: QA cycle 2 at b8630e96 with a scratch build (go build -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza) on scratch roots (rhiza root init) holding projects alpha and folder registered with project add --name other (each with three accepted change sets serving a milestone, one leaf each) and a bare uninitialised checkout, scratch HOME, fake rex/systemctl/make on PATH: with rhiza.daemon.maxRuns = 3 in rhiza.toml one daemon --once started exactly three runs (cycle 1 started six); a second --once started none, skipping alpha cs1/cs2 'has a live run' and alpha cs3 'waiting for a slot'; bare listed 'not initialised'.

QA cycle 2 at b8630e96 with a scratch build (go build -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza) on scratch roots (rhiza root init) holding projects alpha and folder registered with project add --name other (each with three accepted change sets serving a milestone, one leaf each) and a bare uninitialised checkout, scratch HOME, fake rex/systemctl/make on PATH: maxRuns 3 over alpha(3) and other(3) started alpha cs1, other cs1, alpha cs2 (two in alpha, one in other, alternating), and alpha cs3 waited for a slot; on a fresh root with maxRuns 4 and rhiza.project.maxRuns 1 set in alpha, one poll started four runs: alpha cs1 only, and other cs1, cs2, cs3.

QA cycle 2 at b8630e96 with a scratch build (go build -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza) on scratch roots (rhiza root init) holding projects alpha and folder registered with project add --name other (each with three accepted change sets serving a milestone, one leaf each) and a bare uninitialised checkout, scratch HOME, fake rex/systemctl/make on PATH: daemon install from alpha/sub wrote one rhiza-root.service with WorkingDirectory=<root> and ExecStart .../rhiza daemon --autonomous, running systemctl --user daemon-reload and enable --now rhiza-root.service; daemon status at the root and from folder both printed 'Daemon not running / Mode: service' and exited 0 (cycle 1 failed with 'sessions need a git repository'); stop and start at the root, stop from folder and uninstall called systemctl --user stop/start/stop/disable --now rhiza-root.service plus daemon-reload and removed the unit. With a tab-mode daemon running from the root, status at the root and from folder both said 'Daemon running, process rhiza:<pid>'.

QA cycle 2 at b8630e96 with a scratch build (go build -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza) on scratch roots (rhiza root init) holding projects alpha and folder registered with project add --name other (each with three accepted change sets serving a milestone, one leaf each) and a bare uninitialised checkout, scratch HOME, fake rex/systemctl/make on PATH: with rhiza.daemon.selfUpdate true and folder's origin one commit ahead, a foreground daemon with no self_update_project ran no make and left folder at init; with self_update_project = "other" it logged 'self-update: updated to 8b71fbf78', fast-forwarded folder to the newer commit, ran make update with cwd folder, and left alpha untouched.

QA cycle 2 at b8630e96 with a scratch build (go build -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza) on scratch roots (rhiza root init) holding projects alpha and folder registered with project add --name other (each with three accepted change sets serving a milestone, one leaf each) and a bare uninitialised checkout, scratch HOME, fake rex/systemctl/make on PATH: with a daemon running in the background from the root, daemon --permission-mode manual --once from folder exited 2 with 'another daemon holds the lock: process rhiza:<pid>' and next: rhiza daemon status; daemon --once in a dir outside any root exited 2 with 'not inside a Rhiza root' and next: rhiza root init.

QA cycle 2 at b8630e96 with a scratch build (go build -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza) on scratch roots (rhiza root init) holding projects alpha and folder registered with project add --name other (each with three accepted change sets serving a milestone, one leaf each) and a bare uninitialised checkout, scratch HOME, fake rex/systemctl/make on PATH: one daemon --once from the root started runs in both alpha and folder (run logs in each project's own .git/rhiza/logs) and daemon status listed 'Skipped project: bare: not initialised'.

QA cycle 2 at b8630e96 with a scratch build (go build -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza) on scratch roots (rhiza root init) holding projects alpha and folder registered with project add --name other (each with three accepted change sets serving a milestone, one leaf each) and a bare uninitialised checkout, scratch HOME, fake rex/systemctl/make on PATH: with REX_SESSION unset and rex session ls empty, one poll ran rex session new rhiza-alpha (-c alpha) and rhiza-other (-c folder) once each and opened alpha's builder windows with -s rhiza-alpha and folder's with -s rhiza-other; rex.log never names rhiza-folder.
